Is a loose implant crown a dental emergency?

Feeling your dental implant crown move or wiggle can be concerning, particularly when it happens unexpectedly. Many patients experience worry when they notice their implant crown feels loose, wondering whether they need immediate dental attention or can wait for their next routine appointment.

Dental Implants and Blood Thinners: What Patients Should Discuss

Many patients taking anticoagulant medication wonder whether [dental implants](https://www.dental-implants-london.co.uk/dental-implants-cost) are a suitable option for replacing missing teeth. This concern is particularly common among people prescribed warfarin, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, or other blood-thinning medications for conditions such as atrial fibrillation, heart valve disease, or stroke prevention.
